docs.title: GCP Study Hub - Ultimate Google Cloud Certification Study Platform
docs.desc: Free, community-driven study hub for all Google Cloud (GCP) certifications - guides, labs, practice questions, and foundations.
headings: Help Make This the #1 Google Cloud Study Resource

docs.title: Cloud Digital Leader
docs.desc: The entry-level Google Cloud certification. Cloud concepts, Google Cloud products and services, digital transformation, and modernizing infrastructure, data, and operations. No technical background required.

docs.title: Associate Cloud Engineer
docs.desc: Deploy applications, monitor operations, and manage enterprise solutions on Google Cloud. The most popular hands-on GCP cert. Heavy on gcloud, the Console, IAM, networking, and compute.

docs.title: Professional Cloud Architect
docs.desc: Design, develop, and manage robust, secure, scalable, and dynamic solutions on Google Cloud. The most valued GCP certification. Features case studies and solution-design scenarios.

docs.title: Associate Data Practitioner
docs.desc: Demonstrate foundational data skills on Google Cloud: data ingestion, storage, transformation, analysis, and visualization using managed services like BigQuery, Dataflow, and Looker.

docs.title: Associate Google Workspace Administrator
docs.desc: Manage Google Workspace for an organization: provisioning users and groups, configuring services, securing data, and troubleshooting from the Admin console.

docs.title: Professional Cloud Developer
docs.desc: Build scalable and highly available applications using Google-recommended practices and tools. Focus on serverless, containers, APIs, data, and application observability.

docs.title: Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer
docs.desc: Implement SRE practices and CI/CD on Google Cloud: build pipelines, define SLOs and error budgets, manage services, and optimize for reliability and velocity.

docs.title: Professional Cloud Security Engineer
docs.desc: Design and implement secure workloads and infrastructure on Google Cloud: identity and access, network security, data protection, and compliance.

docs.title: Professional Cloud Network Engineer
docs.desc: Design, implement, and manage Google Cloud network architectures: VPC design, hybrid connectivity, network services, and security.

docs.title: Professional Cloud Database Engineer
docs.desc: Design, manage, and migrate scalable database solutions on Google Cloud. Covers Cloud SQL, AlloyDB, Spanner, Bigtable, Firestore, and migrations.

docs.title: Professional Data Engineer
docs.desc: Design and build data processing systems and operationalize ML models on Google Cloud. Heavy on BigQuery, Dataflow, Dataproc, Pub/Sub, and data governance.

docs.title: Professional Machine Learning Engineer
docs.desc: Design, build, and productionize ML models on Google Cloud using Vertex AI and Google-recommended MLOps practices.

docs.title: Compute Engine - Service Deep Dive
docs.desc: Compute Engine deep dive: machine types, Spot VMs, MIGs, images, disks, and networking.

docs.title: Cloud Storage - Service Deep Dive
docs.desc: Cloud Storage deep dive: storage classes, lifecycle, security, and signed URLs.

docs.title: BigQuery - Service Deep Dive
docs.desc: BigQuery deep dive: architecture, partitioning, clustering, pricing, and security.

docs.title: Google Kubernetes Engine - Service Deep Dive
docs.desc: GKE deep dive: Autopilot vs Standard, node pools, networking, and security.

docs.title: Cloud IAM - Service Deep Dive
docs.desc: Cloud IAM deep dive: members, roles, policies, service accounts, and best practices.

docs.title: Pub/Sub - Service Deep Dive
docs.desc: Pub/Sub deep dive: topics, subscriptions, delivery semantics, ordering, and dead-letter topics.

docs.title: Spanner - Service Deep Dive
docs.desc: Spanner deep dive: horizontal scale, strong consistency, multi-region, and schema design.

docs.title: Cloud SQL - Service Deep Dive
docs.desc: Cloud SQL deep dive: HA, read replicas, backups, PITR, and secure connectivity.

docs.title: Vertex AI - Service Deep Dive
docs.desc: Vertex AI deep dive: AutoML, custom training, endpoints, pipelines, feature store, and monitoring.

docs.title: Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) - Service Deep Dive
docs.desc: VPC deep dive: global networks, regional subnets, firewall rules, routing, and connectivity.

docs.title: Dataflow - Service Deep Dive
docs.desc: Dataflow deep dive: Apache Beam, batch vs streaming, windowing, watermarks, and autoscaling.

docs.title: Cloud Run - Service Deep Dive
docs.desc: Cloud Run deep dive: stateless containers, concurrency, scaling, traffic splitting, and integrations.

docs.title: Service Deep Dives
docs.desc: In-depth guides to the core Google Cloud services that appear across every certification exam.

docs.title: Linux Fundamentals
docs.desc: Linux fundamentals for cloud engineers: filesystem, permissions, processes, networking, and shell scripting.

docs.title: Networking Fundamentals
docs.desc: Networking fundamentals for cloud: OSI model, TCP/IP, DNS, CIDR, subnetting, routing, and firewalls.

docs.title: Practice Quiz
docs.desc: Free Google Cloud certification practice quiz with instant scoring, domain breakdowns, and explanations.

docs.title: My Progress

docs.title: Exam Study Planner

docs.title: Confusing Pairs Cheat Sheet
